r: pmdaopenvswitch is a Performance Metrics Domain Agent (PMDA) which exports metric values for each openvswitch virtual switch configured on the local system.

Install the openvswitch PMDA by using the Install script as root:

# cd $PCP_PMDAS_DIR/openvswitch
# ./Install

To uninstall, do the following as root:

# cd $PCP_PMDAS_DIR/openvswitch
# ./Remove

pmdaopenvswitch is launched by pmcd(1) and should never be executed directly. The Install and Remove scripts notify pmcd(1) when the agent is installed or removed.

$PCP_PMDAS_DIR/openvswitch/Install
installation script for the pmdaopenvswitch agent
$PCP_PMDAS_DIR/openvswitch/Remove
undo installation script for the pmdaopenvswitch agent
$PCP_LOG_DIR/pmcd/openvswitch.log
default log file for error messages from pmdaopenvswitch

Environment variables with the prefix PCP_ are used to parameterize the file and directory names used by PCP. On each installation, the file /etc/pcp.conf contains the local values for these variables. The $PCP_CONF variable may be used to specify an alternative configuration file, as described in pcp.conf(5).
